title: Thirty-Eight Years by the Pool
reflectionQuestion: Have you ever stopped believing things could change — and then they did?
reflectionText: Thirty-eight years is a long time to wait for something that never comes — long enough to stop asking, long enough to replace hope with explanation. When Jesus asked, do you want to be made well, the man did not say yes; he explained why it was impossible. Sometimes the thing we most need is not a better system. It is someone who speaks to us as though change is still possible — even when we have stopped believing it ourselves.
